$Comment: The first step of Santa's story: catch Present Thieves, the Trorks in Santa hats who robbed his sleigh.
The _Christmas folder makes the id christmas_present_thieves. The kill step counts this pack's Present
Thief (Target) and the game's own grown Trorks (Targets, the twelve roles the NPC group
Christmas_Game_Trorks names), so a player hunting Trorks anywhere makes progress; the Trork wolves stay
out. Npc.TurnInId, from the base, adds the report-back step to Santa after the hunt.
It pays through Christmas_Chain_Pay, with favor on Santa's Nice List and Festival Favor on its own
Rewards so the quest card shows them, and one Christmas Present, so every player has one to open or
give away. Finishing it opens the dailies, the helpers' part of the story (Bram's Reindeer Food next)
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Defense XP for the hunt, waiting to be collected with the rest.
The row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod,
unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Present_Thieves
